wild_shape.replacement: One known form on each finished Long Rest. No Fly Speed before Druid8; Swim Speed is legal in band. The source permits GM-approved other sources, not every imported monster. No additional source approved here.
wild_shape.projection: Retain type/HP/Hit Dice/mental scores/class features/languages/feats, own skill/save proficiency and PB with higher form modifier rule; Druid-level Temporary HP; no casting; Concentration continues. Full rule retained in source candidate.
wild_shape.equipment: Choose exact-copy drop/merge/wear subject to actual limbs, shape and practical fit; not automatic resizing.

familiar.wild_companion: Same legal normal form set, Fey, Magic action, slot or Wild Shape use, no Material component; ends on owner finished Long Rest.
familiar.pact_command: Magic-action slot-free cast retains Material. Forgo one own Attack-action attack for one familiar attack using its Reaction; not Multiattack action or extra independent turns.
familiar.investment: Warlock5 plus Pact: choose Fly/Swim40; Bonus Action commands Attack action; optional B/P/S -> Necrotic/Radiant; familiar saves use owner DC; owner Reaction grants Resistance to triggering damage. Distinguish save-only actions from attacks and both command routes.
familiar.ordinary_policy: Own initiative and turn, no attacks without specific exception; obey commands; exact familiar identity, 100-foot telepathy/borrowed senses/Touch Reaction, dismissal/recall/recast and exact gear drop from spell source.

animate_dead.target: Small/Medium Humanoid remains within10 feet, one different exact corpse/bone pile per creation; do not reuse remains or assume equipment materializes. Source stat-block gear and actual corpse inventory need reconciliation.
animate_dead.control: 24 hours; reassert before expiry; command eligible own creatures within60 feet with one Bonus Action/same group order, standing orders; absent command Dodge and move only to avoid harm. Control expiry ends obedience, not creature existence.

steeds.policy: Cosmetic animal choices do not import their monster traits. Ordinary controlled-mount movement/action restrictions and actual rider/size remain required.

statblock_path_rule: statblocks/<form-id>.json; candidate ID is srd_<form-id>. Campaign encounter candidate ID is crown_<production-id>. These identities must not collide.
